item.title: Pretty setting! Love the barn! Charlie W. Joyner Homeplace. Over an acre in NC. $125,000
item.description: This is a pretty setting! Love the old trees and that old barn! Wish they showed the inside of that. This is known as the Charlie W. Joyner homeplace. It was built in 1902. It is located on 1.64 acres in Rocky Mount, North Carolina. The house could use some updating and undoing of past renovations, but the price is right. I bet there are wood floors underneath the flooring. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,859 square feet. $125,000 Contact Britt

item.title: Potential! Nice features inside. One acre in Virginia. $225,000
item.description: This house has potential! There are some nice features inside! I bet there are wood floors underneath the carpeting. The house was built in 1900. It is located on 1.05 acres in Heathsville, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, nice staircase, wainscoting, transom window and a spacious kitchen. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property for storage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,286 square feet. $225,000 Contact Robbie Booth with Shore Realty Z

item.title: $64,900! Look at the woodwork! Great pocket doors! C. 1917 in Kansas.
item.description: Check out the woodwork in this house! Pretty pocket doors! And how about that price! The house was built in 1917. It is located in Emporia, Kansas. The house features original wood floors, pretty staircase, beautiful pocket doors, wide baseboards, crown moulding, original mantels, solid wood doors with original hardware, sunroom and chair rails. The backyard is fenced and there is a detached garage. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,952 square feet. $64,900 Contact Erin Woods with CB Emporia Re

item.title: Nice outbuildings! Ten acres in Kentucky. Circa 1901. $235,000
item.description: This house has pretty mantels! Love that it has outbuildings and nice acreage! The house was built in 1901. It is located on 10.28 acres in Cynthiana, Kentucky. The house features a covered front porch, some original wood floors, pretty mantels, a spacious kitchen, baseboards, pocket doors and a nice staircase. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. This is a big house! Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 4,364 square feet. $235,000 Contact Mary Todd Ashbrook with Palmer-Hampton Realty: 85

item.title: Pretty house! Circa 1940 in Louisiana. $259,000
item.description: This is a pretty house! It could use some color inside, but it has nice features. The house was built in 1940. It is located on .5 acre in Marksville, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, pretty front door, leaded glass, wood floors, wide baseboards, crown moulding, french doors, tall ceilings, updated bathrooms, updated kitchen and a pretty fireplace. There is a large garage on the property. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,400 square feet. $259,000 Contact David Moses with Rit

item.title: Love this! “The Marybeth”, Circa 1898 in Louisiana. $625,000
item.description: Love this house! So many great details! Love all of the outdoor spaces, especially that New Orleans’ style outdoor kitchen! Known as “The Marybeth”, it was built in 1898. It is located on .4 acre in St. Martinville, Louisiana. The house features a beautiful front porch, wood floors, nice staircase, built-in bookshelves, baseboards, crown moulding, wainscoting, updated kitchen, built-in corner china cabinet, updated bathrooms and third floor storage. item.title: Great barn! Circa 1900. On 62 acres in Maine. $490,000
item.description: That’s a great barn! Really nice acreage with this house! The home was built in 1900. It is located on 62.5 acres in Windsor, Maine. The house features a covered porch, wood floors, wood stove, wainscoting, stained glass, bay windows and a pretty staircase. There is a large barn and a large garage on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,570 square feet. $490,000 Contact Donna Pinkham with the Masiello Group: donnapinkham@massiello.com From the Zillow listing: Iconic Windsor Farmhouse

item.title: Vintage kitchen! Circa 1913 in Maryland. $85,000
item.description: I like the vintage feel of the kitchen! The house was built in 1913. It is located on .25 acre in Crisfield, Maryland. The house features an enclosed porch, wood floors, vintage kitchen and baseboards. This could be a cute house with some work! It could use some landscaping. There is a detached storage shed on the property. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,184 square feet. $85,000 Contact Cynthia Stevens with Wilson Realty: 410-430-1032 From the Zillow listing: Cute retro house with rear deck, e

item.title: So cute! Cottage in Oak Bluffs on Martha’s Vineyard in Massachusetts. $640,000
item.description: This is so cute! I love the Oak Bluffs cottages on Martha’s Vineyard! They are so expensive though. The cottage was built in 1870. It is located in Oak Bluffs, Massachusetts. I want that bathroom sink! The cottage features a covered front porch, wood floors, vaulted ceiling and stained glass. Lovingly referred to as “Fun Size” and “Baby Vineyard”. One bedroom, one bathroom and 354 square feet. $640,000 From the Zillow listing: Nestled in the heart of the historic Martha’s Vineyard Camp Meeting A

item.title: Double porch love! The Walter Swoope House, Circa 1852 in Mississippi. $439,000
item.description: Double porch love! This house is known as the Walter Swoope House. It was built in 1852. It is located on .5 acre in Columbus, Mississippi. The house features double front porches, a screened in back porch, large outdoor fireplace, huge patio, wood floors, nice staircase, crown moulding, picture rails, wide baseboards, exposed beams in kitchen, french doors and a claw foot tub. The home has fully updated electric and plumbing. Six bedrooms, five bathrooms and 5,200 square feet. $439,000 Contact
